Hi everyone,

I am posting the full instructions for the CSCI-201 take-home midterm in advance so you can plan around the busy Week 7 schedule. The exam window and timing match the course calendar I shared earlier. Please do not wait until the last few hours to download the prompt, complete your work, and upload your final file.

Midterm logistics:
The take-home midterm opens at the start of the posted window and closes at the listed deadline in Canvas.
Submit one PDF named LastName_FirstName_CSCI201_Midterm.pdf.
Make sure the file opens correctly before you upload it.
If you upload the wrong file, a blank document, or a corrupted file, I will grade what is attached in Canvas at the deadline.
You are responsible for checking your submission receipt.

Honor code expectations:
This is an individual assessment.
You may use your course notes, slides, and your own practice work.
You may not work with classmates, share answers, post questions from the exam online, or use outside help to generate solutions.
If you cite any outside source for context, include the citation clearly.

Workload reminder and policy:
I know several of you also have assessments in other classes this week. Please plan backward from the due date now. A heavy week by itself does not automatically qualify for an extension in this course. If you have a documented emergency, illness, or a significant circumstance beyond normal schedule overlap, contact me before the deadline whenever possible.

Late work and extensions:
The midterm is not an open-ended assignment and cannot be accepted late without prior approval for documented extenuating circumstances.
Routine workload, travel, work shifts, and overlapping deadlines in other classes are not, by themselves, grounds for an extension.
If a technical problem affects your submission, take a screenshot immediately and email me with details before the deadline.

I have also attached the same instructions as a PDF for your records.

Best,
Professor Sarah Chen
